dataset.name: NFL
dataset.context: All 32 active NFL franchises as of 2026-10-13, grouped AFC/NFC and eight divisions. Full names are canonical; nickname/brand/abbreviation aliases are provided. Founding year, franchise grant date and first playing season are separate metadata. Historical dates do not imply modern stadium locations. Home coordinates are approximate city reference points from GeoNames/Open-Meteo, not exact stadium points. Sources and the Rams date disagreement are preserved per record. No roster, game schedule or current standings are asserted.
